description: Repairs r-sql-1/agg-numeric: three groups in one statement overflowed together. Asks what exact Double bits Avg, Var, VarP, StDev, StDevP and Sum give for nearly constant values at a large offset (group 10: 1e9 plus 4, 7, 13, 16; group 11: 1e15 plus the same) and for two values of 1e308 (group 12), each group in its own statement and each aggregate in its own statement per group. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-sql1 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
